description: Account join date field stored as string (intended for datetime64[ns]). Contains 29 non-null values out of 30 records (1 missing, 3.3%). One record contains an unparseable value '2025-13-01' with an invalid month component (13). All non-null values are unique. Most values include zeroed time components ('00:00:00') while the unparseable entry uses date-only format.
recommended_actions: [CLARIFY] Confirm the correct value for the unparseable date '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13), verify whether the future date '2027-01-15' represents valid pre-registration or requires correction, and assess whether the 1 missing value (3.3%) is expected for optional join dates.
